market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101.79 May 4. To hit HIGH of $120 by end of June requires ~+18% over ~2 months. May 1 spike only reached ~$106. Would need a meaningful re-escalation or new supply shock. Two months gives more opportunity than a one-month window, but $120 has not traded in 2026 so far.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Probability of a fresh Middle East supply shock between now and end of June.
